description: Black sedan stolen from residential parking lot. No CCTV coverage. Witnesses reported suspicious male loitering near the parking area around 11 PM.
House break-in through back window. Jewellery and cash worth 2 lakhs stolen. Lock was picked. Footprints found near the rear entrance.
Gold chain snatched from a woman walking near the bus stop. Two men on a motorcycle. Victim reported partial number plate.
Red motorcycle stolen from outside a restaurant. Owner was inside for 30 minutes. Nearby shopkeeper noticed two youths tampering with the vehicle.
Victim attacked with a sharp weapon near a park. Dispute over a financial matter. Victim sustained injuries to the arm. Assailant fled on foot.
Armed robbery at a convenience store. Two masked men with knives demanded cash. Approximately 50000 rupees taken. Store CCTV footage available.
Apartment burglarized while family was out of town. Electronics and cash stolen. Entry through unlocked balcony door on first floor.
Suspect apprehended with 200 grams of marijuana near the bus station. Acting suspiciously. No prior criminal record found on initial check.
White SUV stolen from apartment basement parking. Security guard was away from duty. CCTV shows two men breaking the car lock at 12:50 AM.
Online payment fraud. Victim received a fake bank call and shared OTP. 1.5 lakhs transferred to unknown account. Phone number traced to a prepaid SIM.
Elderly woman's gold chain snatched by two men on a motorcycle near the temple. Similar MO to the MG Road incident. Partial plate number noted.
Group altercation outside a pub. Three individuals sustained minor injuries. Triggered by a verbal argument. Bouncers intervened before police arrived.
Office break-in. Laptops and projector stolen. Lock was drilled. Similar method to the January house burglary in the same area.
Multiple parked vehicles damaged with rocks. Approximately 8 cars affected. Believed to be gang-related. No witnesses came forward.
Pedestrian robbed at knifepoint near the railway station. Wallet and phone taken. Victim described the attacker as approximately 25 years old with a scar on the left cheek.
Blue motorcycle stolen from a gated community. CCTV shows the thief entered through the side gate. Similar build and clothing to the January Koramangala thefts.
Employee embezzlement case. Accountant siphoned 5 lakhs over 3 months through falsified invoices. Discovered during internal audit.
Raid near bus station recovered 500 grams of methamphetamine. Three suspects arrested. Connection to earlier marijuana case suspected.
Woman's gold chain snatched while exiting an auto-rickshaw. Two men on a bike with no license plate. Third incident with similar motorcycle description.
Domestic violence complaint. Victim sustained bruises. Neighbors called police after hearing loud altercation. Restraining order requested.
Ground floor house burgled. Thief entered through an open window. Stole laptop and gold ornaments. Dog in the house did not bark suggesting familiarity.
Jewelry shop robbery. Three armed men entered at closing time. Tied up the shopkeeper and stole gold worth 10 lakhs. Vehicle seen fleeing towards Bannerghatta Road.
Auto-rickshaw stolen from a stand at night. Driver reported it missing in the morning. Third auto theft this month in the area.
Ransomware attack on a small IT company. Systems encrypted and 2 Bitcoin ransom demanded. Company had no backups. 15 systems affected.
Real estate fraud. Fake property documents used to sell a plot to two different buyers. Suspect absconded. Losses estimated at 30 lakhs.
Shop windows smashed and walls spray-painted. Appears politically motivated based on slogans. Three shops affected along the same street.
Chain snatching near the water tank junction. Two men on a red motorcycle. Victim chased but lost them. CCTV from nearby ATM being reviewed.
Tourist assaulted and robbed outside a nightclub. Sustained head injury. Wallet and passport stolen. Two suspects seen on CCTV.
Electronics store burglarized. Alarm system was disabled. Phones and laptops worth 8 lakhs stolen. Professional job with clean entry and exit.
Traffic stop led to discovery of 1 kg of hashish in the vehicle. Driver arrested. Vehicle registered to a known offender from Majestic area.
